items.title: JSW MG Motor lines up two new-energy SUVs for FY27 launch, plans ₹1,400 cr investment
items.summary: The company will introduce these 4.3-metre-plus models on its newly-unveiled multi-energy platform ADAPT that will be localised for the Indian market. The ₹1,400 crore investment commitment will support the upcoming product offensive and localisation roadmap.
